name: Lithic
description: Card-issuing API for agent payments: issue virtual cards with spend limits and auth rules, simulate transactions in sandbox. Hosted MCP searches docs and runs live API calls.

skills.name: Issue Virtual Cards
skills.description: Creates account holders and issues virtual cards through the Lithic API, callable from the MCP server's execute-request tool.

skills.name: Set Agent Spend Limits
skills.description: Sets card spending limits and authorization rules that decide in real time which transactions an agent's card can make.

skills.name: Simulate Card Transactions
skills.description: Follows sandbox workflows to simulate authorizations and clearing and to test authorization rules before going live.

skills.name: Search API Docs
skills.description: Searches Lithic documentation and inspects endpoint schemas without an API key, to generate integration code.
